tags.name: regional
tags.description: The regional's public face: its name, language, colours and logo, and the public document the shell reads at boot.

get.summary: The regional's public values and the terms in every language. No session needed. ETag is derived from the settings revision; a matching If-None-Match answers 304.

304.description: The If-None-Match tag is the current one.

get.summary: The regional's brand colours as a stylesheet; an empty body when both are the shipped palette. No session needed. ETag and 304 as for /public.

304.description: The If-None-Match tag is the current one.

get.summary: The regional's logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP). No session needed. The shell requests it as /api/regional/logo?v=<logo>, the file ID from the public document; the query is ignored. ETag is the image's SHA-256 and a matching If-None-Match answers 304. 404 when there is no logo; 503 with Retry-After on a copy that has not yet received the image.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: The logo's file ID, to version the URL; ignored.

304.description: The If-None-Match tag is the image's.

put.summary: Replace the logo. Needs settings.manage. multipart/form-data with one file part named file (PNG, JPEG or WebP by its bytes, at most 2 MiB; metadata is removed). Field errors use the field file: too_large {max}, type, malformed, required. 409 with code quota when the site is out of file space; 503 read_only on a read-only copy.

200.description: The revision and the new logo's file ID.

delete.summary: Remove the logo. Needs settings.manage. With no logo it changes nothing and answers the current revision and an empty logo. 503 read_only on a read-only copy.

200.description: The revision and an empty logo.

contact_email.description: The regional's shared mailbox, shown to anyone; empty when none.

public_url.description: No trailing slash; empty when unset.

language.description: The language before a person chooses.

timezone.description: An IANA name; empty means the browser's zone.

logo.description: The logo's file ID; empty when there is none. Request /api/regional/logo?v=<logo>, so a replaced logo is a new URL.

terms.description: Per language, the term arguments: term_<term>, term_<term>_plural, term_<term>_title, term_<term>_plural_title.

file.description: The image: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 2 MiB (2097152 bytes). Send it as the only part.

logo.description: The file ID after the call; empty after a removal.
